source: OpenAlex API /works (IDs written from the response by scripts/run_search.py)
query: (micromobility OR "e-scooter" OR "bike-sharing" OR dockless) AND (urban OR city) AND (equity OR governance OR regulation)
filter: title_and_abstract.search.exact:(micromobility OR "e-scooter" OR "bike-sharing" OR dockless) AND (urban OR city) AND (equity OR governance OR regulation),is_retracted:false,publication_year:2022-2026
oql:
get works where retracted is (false)
  and year >= (2022)
  and year <= (2026)
  and title-abstract has (("bike-sharing" OR "dockless" OR "e-scooter" OR "micromobility") AND ("city" OR "urban") AND ("equity" OR "governance" OR "regulation"))
